meta.name: agent-manager-skill
meta.description: Manage multiple local CLI agents via tmux sessions (start/stop/monitor/assign) with cron-friendly scheduling.

copy.tagline: 通过 tmux 会话管理多个本地 CLI agent
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在终端中同时运行和监控多个 agent 进程
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple local CLI agents via tmux sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run and monitor multiple agent processes in terminal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理多个本地命令行智能体，每个在独立的 tmux 会话中运行。它能启动、停止、监控智能体，分配任务并查看日志。
howto.when: 当需要同时运行多个本地 CLI 智能体，或要启动、停止、监控、分配任务以及定时调度智能体工作时触发。

say.note: Claude 会运行 start 命令启动该智能体。
Claude 会运行 list 命令显示智能体列表。

say.text: 给 EMP_0002 分配维护任务
say.note: Claude 会运行 assign 命令并传入任务内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage multiple local CLI agents, each in a separate tmux session. It can start, stop, monitor agents, assign tasks, and tail logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to run multiple local CLI agents in parallel, or to start, stop, monitor, assign tasks, or schedule recurring agent work.

say_en.note: Claude runs the start command for that agent.
Claude runs the list command to show agents.
Claude runs assign with the task content.
